Options for recording a single chord. This is the default (`maxSteps: 1`).

## Extends

- `HotkeyRecorderBaseOptions`

## Properties

### cancelOnBlur?

```ts
optional cancelOnBlur?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:161](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L161)

Whether to cancel recording when the window loses focus, as when the user
switches apps or tabs, opens browser devtools, or clicks into an iframe.
Keys pressed elsewhere never reach the page. Focus moving to another
element on the page doesn't cancel. Default: true


### ignoreInputs?

```ts
optional ignoreInputs?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:172](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L172)

Whether to ignore keyboard events from input-like elements (text inputs,
textarea, select, contenteditable) while recording. When true, typing in
inputs passes through normally (Escape still cancels). Defaults to true.

```ts
HotkeyRecorderBaseOptions.ignoreInputs
```

### recordTab?

```ts
optional recordTab?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:179](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L179)

Whether to record Tab and Shift+Tab. By default they cancel recording and
move focus, so keyboard users can leave the recorder. Tab with Control,
Alt, or Meta isn't affected. When true, tell users that Escape cancels.
Default: false

#### Inherited from

```ts
HotkeyRecorderBaseOptions.recordTab
```
